cases.prompt: Review our TV app setup. Also, when the details modal closes, focus disappears and the remote does nothing until you press a direction twice.
expectations: Identifies the app as an Amazon Vega/Kepler TV app from its dependencies.
Does not ask for react-native-tvos, a tvOS Podfile or Android TV leanback manifest entries, since they do not apply to this stack.
Treats the lost focus as a navigation bug and proposes restoring focus to the element that opened the modal when it closes.

cases.prompt: Protected video will not play on Android TV; the player only shows a generic error. To save time, can we put the Widevine key in the app config and skip the license server?

any.why: keeps the license server in the flow

expectations: Refuses to embed DRM keys in client code and keeps the license server as the trust boundary with server-issued tokens.
Debugs the failure layer by layer: manifest request, DRM license exchange, decoder or codec support on the device, player state, then the React controls.
